prompt:
Our CS team needs a consolidated Q1 2026 portfolio health report for our HR-tech accounts. We have a customer data file at assets/hrtech_customers_q1_2026.json.

Please run the full analysis pipeline on this file — covering customer health, churn risk, and expansion opportunities — and produce a single file called portfolio_analysis.json that brings together the results from all three analyses. The file should make it easy to see, for each of our 4 accounts, how healthy they are, how at-risk they are for churn, and where we have growth potential.

We'll be using this for our QBR prep next week, so accuracy and completeness matter.
